title: Layer-by-layer assembly of tetra-Mn-containing 30-tungsto-4-phosphate, [M4(H2O)2(P2W15O56)2]n− (M = MnII and MnIII) with AuNps-MWCNT: electrochemical detection of iodate
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,15252-15265
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA01691B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Suganya Pitchai Muthusamy, Indherjith Sakthinathan, Timothy McCormac
This study demonstrates the Layer-by-Layer approach to assemble the [M4(H2O)2(P2W15O56)2]n− (M = MnII and MnIII) polyoxometalates with gold nanoparticles (AuNps) decorated multi-walled carbon nanotubes (MWCNT) on carbon electrode surfaces.
